verdict.why: Config files in ancestor directories are no longer found, so a different config is used.

draft.detail: When no --config option is provided, Vitest looks for the config file in the project root; if no config file is found, Vitest runs without one.

test.error: FAIL: vitest run in sub loaded vitest.config.mjs from the parent directory

source.quote: When an explicit `--config` option is not provided, Vitest looks for `vitest.config.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs}` first and `vite.config.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs}` second in the project [`root`](/config/root). If no config file is found, Vitest will run without one.
